name: Kanak Manjari Sahoo

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Kanak Manjari Sahoo is an Odia short-story writer and translator whose work brings Bengali and Hindi literature to Odia readers. Her author biography lists the story collection Ashtaraga alongside translations of Zakir Hussain and Sunil Gangopadhyay, as well as collections of folktales. Sahitya Akademi’s catalogue records her translation of Laghu Katha Sangrah, adding a documented title to this wider practice of carrying stories between languages.

Her brief poem “The wheels of time have run over them” presents a traveller who has not yet reached the hoped-for destination. Obstacles remain, but the movement continues. Time, first imagined as something that can crush, opens into sky and fields around the path: an unfinished journey held within a spacious landscape.
